name: EMBERWELL

entities.name: Keeper's note
entities.dialogueText: HOLD SPACE TO FIRE THE PUFFER PACK. IT RUNS ON STEAM: VENTS AND CELLS REFILL IT.
dialogueMore: X PICKS THINGS UP AND THROWS THEM. YOUR SPEED GOES WITH THEM.
BRING ALL FOUR EMBER HEARTS BACK TO THE FURNACE LIFT.

entities.name: Warren sign
entities.dialogueText: MITES. DUSKOWLS EAT THEM AND LEAVE SWEEPS ALONE. GLIMMERBATS FEAR OWLS.

entities.name: Toolbox sign
entities.dialogueText: A SWEEP'S OLD TOOLBOX. THE CUTTER INSIDE FIRES ON F AND CUTS RUBBLE.

entities.name: Cistern sign
entities.dialogueText: THE SLUICE OPENS WHEN SOMETHING HEAVY SITS ON THE PLATE BELOW.
dialogueMore: THE ANVIL STONE IS TOO HEAVY TO FLY WITH. IT ONLY GOES DOWN.

entities.name: Grotto sign
entities.dialogueText: GLOWCAPS. SOMETHING IN THE GULLET CAN SMELL THEM FROM HERE.

entities.name: Bell sign
entities.dialogueText: THE OLD BELL OPENS THE BRASS GATE. ONLY A PEBBLE FITS THE HOLE.
dialogueMore: HOLD DOWN AS YOU THROW TO ROLL IT. THE GEYSER IN THE WEST CORNER TAKES YOU BACK UP.
